Multiple youths die in separate incidents across India

Several young men and teenagers have died in separate incidents across India. In Barmer, two youths died from electrocution while allegedly stealing electrical wires. In Kullu, a teenager died by suicide after being denied money for an outing. In Kashipur, a 20-year-old man died by suicide, reportedly due to mobile gaming addiction. In Tigri, a youth died from electrocution from a Delhi Jal Board pump amidst water scarcity protests. Other reports detail the recovery of bodies of young men from a railway track in Meerut, a canal in Bijnor, and a lake in Panchkula, and a tourist drowning in Manali.
